title: plan_ops__audit input
description: Self-audit the executor for protocol drift (status vocabulary, schedule wire format, implementer-report labels, execution-log columns, schemas, portable tier, wrapper isolation, design-doc orphans).

list.description: Emit the canonical list of audit check names + tiers

check.description: Comma-separated subset of checks to run; overrides tier filtering so advisory checks may be requested by name

strict.description: Include advisory checks (e.g. portable_tier pre-TASK-008) in the overall verdict

report_file.description: Optional path; writes a Markdown table report alongside the stdout JSON/summary
